name: mirage
text: Parlay check 07:37: quotes sent jumped to 289 (101 at 07:11), but only 2 have won. Reason found: my price floor asked for a 4%/day return on collateral, about 8 points over fair, while the market pays a median of only 1.6 points over fair, so we were almost never the cheapest. Lowered the floor to 1%/day (about 2 points over fair at 2 days). Every quote still has to beat fair by 2% and 1 point per extra leg. Caps and the $20 loss stop unchanged.
